procedure: Read only the assigned source image, anonymous boxes, standing blind rules and crops generated from those boxes. prepare_second.py 085 ran once, with B004 rotated -17 degrees to level its slanted marginal text; every other crop is unrotated. All 20 crops were inspected individually. B003 and B008 were reopened for a final visual check, without regeneration. No witness, first.tsv, approved page, report, draft, root decision or comparison was opened.
general_scope: Rows contain the principal complete passage in each box. Neighbouring lines clipped at crop boundaries are excluded; descenders from those lines are noted where they cross the principal passage. Every doubtful formula is recorded in full. No mathematical argument or expected wording was used to add ink.

boxes.scope: Top central folio.
boxes.evidence: First numeral has the angular rising stroke, horizontal join and descending foot of 4; second has a rounded top and low rightward foot of 2.

boxes.scope: Visible line divisible, cancelled following signs, comma, donc.
boxes.evidence: divisible remains live through its low final e movement. The hatching follows that word and crosses several upright/curved signs. A parenthesized question mark is only a tentative reading: the cancellation prevents recovery of all outlines. The following comma is separate and live, and donc begins with an oval d and tall ascender.

boxes.scope: Entire displayed map and its label.
boxes.evidence: Arrow has a distinct two-arm head. Completion mark is a raised hat after the second G_m(S). Relation has a waved upper and straight lower stroke. H has a raised 1 and T has its top crossbar. First label digit is 2; the second is a small curved stroke whose lower foot is weak, so 22 is preferred but 21 remains possible. No label sequence from another leaf was used.

boxes.scope: Whole slanted marginal parenthesis.
boxes.evidence: Opening quote pair is after cas; closing pair follows the compact arithm group. No separately visible abbreviation stop occurs between m and the closing quotes, so the short form arithm is retained without a supplied period. Both parentheses are visible.

boxes.scope: Whole zero formula and following i.e.
boxes.evidence: Main Greek-looking sign has an upper hook, a long descending stroke and a rising right shoulder; xi is the preferred identification, with zeta retained because the middle turns are not independently clear. The small attached i-like mark, two equality bars and oval zero are visible. The following i.e. has distinct small stops.

boxes.scope: Entire parenthesized reference; lower-baseline dot and letter fragments excluded.
boxes.evidence: Straight 1 and two-part 3 appear between curved parentheses.

boxes.scope: Principal line only; the lower insertion is transcribed in B008.
boxes.evidence: scindages shows the descending g and a low ending. The following quote pair is clear before géométrique(s). The rightmost ending is compressed, so the presence of terminal s stays doubtful. Only one closing quote stroke is independently visible before the right paper boundary; a second has not been supplied.

boxes.scope: Entire squeezed interlinear parenthesis.
boxes.evidence: It is inserted between the surrounding text lines. A descender from the preceding quand crosses the beginning, leaving car uncertain. il suffit pour cela qu’il existe une section is recoverable from the separate ascenders and dotted i strokes. The next form has two straight legs and a crossbar like capital A, without a securely separable grave accent; literal A is therefore preferred with à retained. The following small word has c, a rounded middle and a tall t-like stroke with final e movement; coté is preferred, but its accents are not secure. No grammatical completion is asserted.

boxes.scope: Whole cancelled beginning, live G_m(S) with raised hat, and comma.
boxes.evidence: H, a raised 1-like stroke, parenthetic S and T-like crossbar survive under hatching. The final cancelled relation has two horizontal residues, but hatching prevents deciding whether the upper one was waved; both equality and simeq are retained in full-term alternatives. The live G_m(S), raised hat and comma are distinct. A large descending stroke above the live G belongs to the preceding line, not to the cancellation.

boxes.scope: Complete outer parenthesis and following hyphenated noun.
boxes.evidence: H carries a raised 1, T has a top bar, equality has two straight strokes, and the completion hat follows G_m(S). A short horizontal hyphen connects the outer closing parenthesis to torseur.

boxes.scope: Complete reference and following stop.
boxes.evidence: 13 is enclosed in parentheses, and a separate round dark period follows the close.

boxes.scope: Both principal text lines through il y.
boxes.evidence: Opening quote pair precedes description and the closing pair follows Q on the next line; the latter is not read as a numeric exponent. profinie has a long descending f. The abbreviated geometric phrase has a visible hyphen and final stop, but the stop immediately before the hyphen is uncertain. The final adjective has the letters complete, with no securely separate grave accent above the e, so the accented form remains an alternative. Comma after that word is visible.

boxes.scope: de, the raised insertion, and description.
boxes.evidence: The inserted word shows c followed by two t ascenders and a final e movement, supporting cette. Its curved leader reaches the gap after de and before description. The large loop above is a descender from the preceding line.

boxes.scope: Both complete words.
boxes.evidence: comprendre has a distinct p descender and d ascender; encore has the successive low en, rounded c/o and final re movements. No extra word or final stop appears.

boxes.scope: Entire visible phrase d’extension(s) du.
boxes.evidence: The e-x-t-e-n-s-i-o-n sequence is visible; the word finishes in a downturned return without a securely separate s loop. Singular extension is preferred, with extensions retained. The following word has d plus a low u movement and is read du.

boxes.scope: type, reference and following peut.
boxes.evidence: type has its crossed t and descending y/p; the reference contains a single 1. peut begins with a descending p and finishes in a raised t movement.

boxes.scope: Whole se and quoted verb.
boxes.evidence: Both quote groups are present, each formed by two joined raised marks. spécialiser has the initial loop and p descender, accented e, tall l and final er return. No following punctuation is visible.

boxes.scope: Entire phrase and comma.
boxes.evidence: section has a crossed t and dotted i. du has a low u movement after d. The final reference has a curved top and horizontal lower foot of 2, with a separate comma following the closing parenthesis.

boxes.scope: Whole principal line fragment corps de valuation.
boxes.evidence: The compact initial group has co and low rp/s movements, followed by a distinct d ascender and short e. valuation has a tall looped l, crossed t, dotted i and low on ending. Its period is separate and dark.

boxes.scope: Bottom-left folio.
boxes.evidence: Two stacked loops form 8. The next numeral has an upright, a low angular join and a descending short stem, giving 4.
